label: Видимый
description: A 10-sentence card for видимый, the present passive participle of видеть.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative. Видимый comes from видеть — the second-conjugation form видим plus -ый. It agrees with masculine берег and has lexicalized into the adjective visible.
Strategic focus: Feminine nominative. The feminine ending -ая lets видимая agree with граница. The -им- suffix marks the second conjugation, and the word means the visible boundary.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative. Видимое carries the neuter ending -ое to match пространство. As a present passive participle it literally means the space that is seen.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative. The plural ending -ые lets видимые agree with звёзды. The participle declines like an adjective and names the visible stars.

Strategic focus: Masculine accusative. With the inanimate masculine object спектр the participle keeps видимый as the spectrum we study. Видимый спектр equals спектр, который видят — the spectrum that people see.
Strategic focus: Feminine genitive. Видимой takes the feminine genitive ending to agree with части, marking the visible part of the moon as the source of the edge.
Strategic focus: Masculine dative. The dative noun прогрессу pulls видимому into the dative -ому ending. The word names the visible progress that gladdens us.
Strategic focus: Masculine instrumental. After довольна the noun результатом stands in the instrumental, and видимым takes the matching instrumental ending to agree with the visible result.
Strategic focus: Masculine prepositional. The preposition о governs the prepositional case, so мире and видимом both take prepositional endings and agree as the visible world we argue about.

Strategic focus: Plural lexicalization. Видимые here works as the adjective apparent, formed from видим with -ые. It agrees with plural причины and shows the participle fully settled into everyday vocabulary.
